calibration_prerequisite: Pass both range_plane_calibration.wbt and range_plane_calibration_far.wbt before changing the camera mount, optical axis, projection, near clip, or pixel resampling.

direction_markers.body_left_and_up: top-left image quadrant; measured nearest depth 1.55987 m
direction_markers.body_right_and_down: bottom-right image quadrant; measured nearest depth 1.53276 m

resampling.method: Map each target slope v in [-0.75, 0.75] to the nearest native row under tanV=0.8; take the closer adjacent axial depth conservatively; convert with target ray norm; then 2x2 min-pool to 8x10.
resampling.pose_history_origin: RangeFinder world position, computed as body GPS position plus body-to-world rotation times [0.08, 0, 0]. The current query pose remains the vehicle body center.
resampling.near_clip_correction: None. Two plane distances agree with the measured camera pose and pixel ray; no empirical depth offset is applied.

provenance: R2025a RangeFinder API returns metric axial depth and stores rows top-to-bottom: https://github.com/cyberbotics/webots/blob/R2025a/docs/reference/rangefinder.md
The camera axis and mount were selected by the measured +X plane and left/up marker tests, not by generic OpenGL axis assumptions.
